ui.subtitle: Modern and fast YouTube video downloader

cli.help_quality: Quality mode: 'best' = max available resolution with no cap (h264/aac preferred at equal quality), 'cap:N' = cap height at N. Omit for legacy format selection.
cli.help_subs: Also download subtitles as .vtt sidecar files (manual preferred over auto-generated).
cli.help_sub_langs: Subtitle language patterns, comma-separated, order = priority (default: "ko.*,en.*")
cli.help_manifest: Write a JSON download manifest to the given path.
cli.help_verify: Verify each download: size, duration, audio loudness, oEmbed title, resolution.
cli.help_id_names: Name output files by video ID instead of title (safe for scripted batches).
cli.already_max: ℹ️  Source caps at {height}p — already max available quality.
cli.help_audio_lang: Audio language: a code like 'en' or 'ko' forces that audio track; 'auto' (default) picks the video's original spoken track when multiple dub tracks exist.
cli.help_captions_langs: Comma-separated caption languages (e.g. "ko,en"). Per language the best source is used: manual → auto-generated → YouTube auto-translated (rate-limited; a robust pipeline falls back to an external translation step keyed off the manifest). Implies --write-subs.
